entities.summary: ExxonMobil Oil Discovery and the Oil Boom, a transformative movement in Guyana (2015–2025). Emerged from ExxonMobil discovers Liza field in Stabroek Block and Guyana positions as leader in climate finance via LCDS framework. Catalyzed First oil production — December 2019 and Contested 2020 election — five-month recount before PPP declared winner.
